column1: # title: G-rich loci recovered from human blood plasma cfDNA, characterised individually by CD
# why_this_panel: the buffer is a near-physiological mixed-cation composition (132 mM Na+, 5 mM K+,
#   1.5 mM Mg2+, 10 mM sodium phosphate, pH 7.4, 25 C, 20 uM DNA). That region of condition space is
#   thin in G4STAB and G4ShapePredictor, which are the collections behind the g4_tm and g4_topology
#   heads, so this tests the condition axis where the training data is weakest rather than where it
#   is densest. The measurements were posted after the model artifact above was frozen.
# extraction_status: PENDING -- the 50 synthesised oligonucleotides and their CD calls are reported
#   in the preprint's supplementary material. Fill one row per oligonucleotide from the supplement.
#   Record the CD call as observed_folded 1/0 and the assigned topology verbatim; leave
#   observed_topology empty rather than guessing where the spectrum is described as mixed.
# do_not: do not add the 8,316 cfDNA-enriched genomic intervals here. They are a fragmentomic
#   proxy, not a folding measurement, and mixing them into this file would turn an external
#   biophysical panel into a genomic-association set with no label to say so.
